system.description:
Psionics: Keen Meditation · cast at A-Rank to S-Rank · no type

Two ranks of Mastery with Genjutsu attacks.

A critical hit with a Genjutsu attack adds 2d12 psychic damage.

Once per creature per long rest, psychic damage that would reduce it to 0 can leave it unconscious at 1 hit point.

rules.text: A critical hit with a Genjutsu attack adds 2d12 psychic damage.
The first time you'd reduce a creature to 0 hit points with psychic damage, you can have it fall unconscious at 1 hit point instead (once per creature, per long rest).
